title: Decide from History: a triage drawer walks the undecided, brief in view
deviations_from_card: (1) No auto-advance on the pick. The card says a decision 'moves to the next one', but DispositionEditor only shows the reason field after a disposition is picked. Jumping away on the pick would make a reason for advance/hold impossible to write in the drawer. So a landed decision repaints the row in place and the recruiter moves on with j or Next, which is afterDecision's target: the next row the mode still walks, null at the end, no wrap. The drawer's queue is triageQueueAround, which keeps the decided row on screen as the anchor. (2) The editor prop is onSettled(outcome) instead of the carded onSaved. It fires on success, on refusal and on the keepalive unmount flush. The host applies an outcome only through shouldApplySave, so the carded pure gate is the one rule, and a note flushed while moving on still repaints the row. ResultPanel does not pass the prop, so the report behaves exactly as before. (3) Three cases beyond the card's 8, 11 in total: triageQueueAround anchoring, pruneToFilter on close, and a source-wiring guard. The guard checks there is no PATCH in the drawer, that the editor is keyed, that the Decide button is present and that the slug link is kept. isTypingTarget is also exported and tested; a checkbox, used to tick flags, does not count as typing. (4) The drawer is imported statically. The critic's note holds: next/dynamic does not reduce check-budget's count. (5) The loading state uses LoadingGap (role=status) instead of a silent reveal-quiet aria-hidden box, because loading-gap-debt.test.ts treats a new silent box as undeclared debt. (6) Extra keys beyond the card: decideOn (aria-label), triageDoneOfLoaded, triageProgressOfLoaded, triagePosition, triageOpenReport, triageSkipDecided, triageKeys.
notes: Premise re-verified at a16df4d6e. DispositionEditor has one mount, at ResultPanel.tsx:261. The editor's success branch had no host callback. Slot A's HistoryTab (rows replaced per query, appended by loadMore) is the base, and the drawer only touches rows through applyDecision/pruneToFilter. No read->write was added: every write is the existing PATCH, which already compare-and-swaps. No new route, error code, schema or refusal. On open, the drawer repaints the row from GET /api/analyses/[slug] (server truth), so a stale list row is corrected. The drawer uses the server's candidateLabel, which is masked under the consent gate. It gets decision tokens only from the PATCH answer. A viewer seat's 403 FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY is shown by the editor through useErrorMessage and changes nothing. GATES: tsc is clean on my paths. The whole-tree reds are all foreign: stop/[token]/language (comms-locale-optout, since committed), devcaseIntakeState.test.ts (devcase-lifecycle/B in flight) and the untracked kpi-sim/ tree. The full test:unit exits 1. loading-gap-debt was mine and is fixed before commit. The remaining BROKEN files are all a sibling's: public-body-cap-contract and route-capability-coverage (stop/[token]/language POST, comms-locale-optout, in flight at run time) and devcase-studio-robustness (devcase-lifecycle/B uncommitted), plus the known environmental python-runner process-tree case. PERF: I measured on git-archive copies. HEAD ceecc1d2c alone gave app/page.tsx 1453 / 9249 KB. With this card's five files it gave 1455 / 9267 KB, so +2 modules and +18 KB. Only that share was raised, in c673aad09 (1453/9255 -> 1455/9273, with a why). Committed HEAD 8a9b37e85 measures 1455 / 9267: within budget. The working tree reads 9292 KB only because of the devcase sibling's uncommitted files. review:constitution --base a16df4d6e --head HEAD found nothing. No route or auth guard was touched: the PATCH still asks requireCapabilityCoded('pipeline:write') and the GET asks 'read'. Catalog keys are in all four locales with real cs/de/fr text, committed alone under the lock (ceecc1d2c). The doc is committed alone under the lock (c5d933070).
loop_open: none. The card adds no refusal, gate or stored status. Two surfaces show the recorded decision. The History row and its filter are repainted in place by applyDecision and pruned by pruneToFilter on close. The report, /history/[slug] and the pipeline echo read the server, which the same PATCH wrote. The palette preview cache (app/features/shell/palette/previewCache.ts) has the same pre-existing staleness after any decision, whether made on the report page or here. The card puts it out of scope because r08 workspace-shell-core owns that file. It is not a new gap from this card.
